detail.longDescription: Google DeepMind has used agentic AI to formally verify key cryptographic guarantees of the Signal protocol, an independent check of code used by Signal, Google Messages and WhatsApp. The four-week proof of concept found no new flaws, but caught known ones in older versions. The specification and proofs are being released. https:// arstechnica.com/ai/2026/11/sig nals-encryption-just-passed-an-ai-powered-mathematical-checkup/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
